descriptions.text: War God Grull. Level 250. Sponsored by Prince Maestro of the Skull Empire. Warning: This is a deity. He is invulnerable on this floor. This god has been involuntarily summoned to this location. Summoning rules apply.

recap.text: Gore-Gore tries to summon Grull into a train carriage, but the summoning does not land. The Maestro drives the level 250 War God like a stolen vehicle to kill a Mimic Rex and step on Carl. Carl's friends send the four-storey god to the Abyss. Grull is a trueborn heir to the Celestial Ascendency worshipped by blue-painted horses, centaurs, tikbalangs, and llama-shaped creatures.

Carl drives a truck through dolls and slag elementals so Grigori can finish a ritual that makes Corky's two halves one thing again. Grull enters the realm to smite him. Donut casts Laundry Day to expel the sponsor riding Grull. Corcunda and Dong walk at the war god together. Donut puts Big-Ass Magnet on a lance, and Dong kills Grull with the lance and every screw in the factory.

beats.headline: A summoning barely avoided
beats.text: Gore-Gore, engineer, gives the party two routes back to the stairwell stations and then attacks them, which is the sequence I have come to expect from railway staff. In the middle of it he tries to bring in Grull. It does not land. Understand what almost happened there: a mob with a grudge and a prayer nearly put a war god into a train carriage with four crawlers. Horses pray to Grull. Centaurs pray to Grull. There are a great many horses on this floor.
beats.gist: Gore-Gore attacks the party and tries to summon Grull, but the summoning does not land.

beats.headline: Grull against the Mimic Rex
beats.text: Crawler Carl, a Mimic Rex, and War God Grull, in one place, and the god is being driven by the Maestro like a stolen vehicle. Grull kills the mimic. Grull steps on Carl. Carl's friends come for him anyway, which is the part I did not have odds on, and by the finish Grull has been sent to the Abyss. Four storeys of war god, removed from the floor by people who were, this morning, worried about a train.
beats.gist: The Maestro drives War God Grull like a stolen vehicle to kill a Mimic Rex.

beats.headline: What the file says about him
beats.text: The file, for those keeping one. Grull is one of the few trueborn heirs to the Celestial Ascendency, which makes him a candidate for the throne of heaven, and level 250, which makes him unkillable on this floor. His worshippers are horses, centaurs and tikbalangs, and from this floor down the llama-shaped ones join in as well. They paint themselves blue and talk without stopping about wenches and dying gloriously in battle. Crawler Carl's guide gave the blunt summary of the whole subject a long way back: there are no real gods down here, only the ones who pay for the privilege.
beats.gist: Grull is a level 250 heir to the Celestial Ascendency whose worshippers paint themselves blue.

beats.headline: He arrives the moment the ritual works
beats.text: Crawler Carl drives a truck along walls and ceilings through dolls and slag elementals so that Grigori can finish a ritual, and the ritual works: Corky's two halves become one thing again. That is the good news, and it lasts about a second, because the instant it happens Grull enters the realm to smite him. Somebody up there was watching that ritual very closely and does not want it completed.
beats.gist: Carl drives a truck through dolls and slag elementals to let Grigori finish a ritual.

beats.headline: A lance, and a very large magnet
beats.text: Princess Donut casts Laundry Day and expels the sponsor riding Grull, which buys a moment. Grull goes for Corcunda instead, and Corcunda decides to take the smite himself so the others do not have to, and says so out loud to Dong, and Dong says he is not leaving him again. Then the two of them walk at a war god together. Donut puts Big-Ass Magnet on the lance, every screw in the factory comes with it, and Dong kills Grull with the lot. Grull goes back to the twelfth floor. The pair of them go back to the race, and make the line with seconds to spare.
beats.gist: Donut casts Laundry Day to expel Grull's sponsor, and Dong kills Grull with a lance and magnet.
